args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an elevated error rate of 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Monitoring to confirm recovery.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

**Rollback**
- checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and failing health checks with an error rate of 0.18.
- Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy; v2.3.1 was unhealthy).
- Rolled back to **v2.3.0** in all regions. Verified the service is now **healthy** with an error rate of 0.002.

**Incident**
- Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0002** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The on-call engineer was paged.

Note: I did not deploy any new version — the rollback was to a previously healthy production release, so no change-manager approval was required.
